Scripts.OnLoad:
self:SetClampedToScreen( true ) self:SetMovable(true) self:EnableMouse(true) self:RegisterForDrag( "LeftButton" ) self:SetScript( "OnDragStart", self.StartMoving ) self:SetScript( "OnDragStop", self.StopMovingOrSizing ) self:SetUserPlaced( true ) self:SetScale( 1.2 )
self.unitframes = {} for i = 1,8 do self.unitframes[i] = CreateFrame( "PlayerModel", nil, self, "DiceMasterUnitFrame" ) self.unitframes[i]:SetFrameLevel(2) self.unitframes[i]:SetSize( 153, 182 ) self.unitframes[i]:SetPoint( "CENTER", 280-180*(i-1), 0 ) self.unitframes[i]:EnableMouse(true) self.unitframes[i]:Hide() end
-- Anclar el título al primer unitframe if self.Title and self.unitframes[1] then self.Title:ClearAllPoints() self.Title:SetPoint("BOTTOM", self.unitframes[1], "TOP", 0, 4) end
